the potential effects of drinking water contaminants on birth outcomes.
the effects of drinking water contaminants on adverse birth outcomes.

the evidence is insufficient for a cause-effect relationship between drinking water contaminants and birth defects.

the studies reviewed here do provide evidence of adverse effects from chlorination disinfection products on pregnancy outcomes.
the current epidemiologic evidence does not support a strong association between drinking water contaminants and adverse birth outcomes.
